verdict.rationale: Weave's own signals feature is described as built-in and custom signals that automatically capture and classify agent interactions, and users can create custom signals to tag agent turns. That amounts to automated scoring of live traffic, backed by guardrail safety and quality scorers and the ability to test models against production traces. However, the core Evaluation docs center on datasets and repeatable test cases, and continuous online evaluation is evidenced mainly through marketing-level claims. missing for 10: in-depth docs on configuring scorers or LLM judges to run continuously on sampled production calls (sampling, filters, scheduling), and independent or hands-on corroboration of online evaluation.
